notes.title: Early access release date
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As we approach our early access release date, we're excited to announce that Ratten Reich will be available for everyone to enjoy this Friday, the 9th. We wanted to take a moment to connect with you and help set some expectations. First and foremost, we want to thank all of you for your incredible support and motivation throughout this journey. Ratten Reich is our debut project, and while we've learned a lot and faced challenges along the way, we never gave up. We've worked tirelessly to bring the game to you on time.

Our team is small—just a few passionate individuals who left our previous jobs to pursue this dream. We are dedicated to creating great RTS games that provide memorable experiences for our fans. It's important to note that this is an early access release. The game may lack some features and may have bugs or issues. However, we are committed to addressing any critical problems promptly and will continue developing the game with your feedback and involvement. Early access allows us to engage you even more in the development process. We plan to release monthly updates with new content and features.

This launch is a significant moment for us, and we've poured our hearts into making Ratten Reich something special. We understand the pressure and the high stakes, but we hope for your support and understanding. Our team is dedicated to delivering an unforgettable experience, and we dream of growing enough to compete with the big studios, bringing back the RTS feel to your fingertips. Thank you for being part of this journey with us, and we can't wait for you to dive into Ratten Reich!

We would also like to give our comic to all early access players. It will be included in the game.

notes.title: Dear Comrades,
notes.content:
Dear Comrades,

We've closely monitored the feedback from our Ratten Reich demo during the Steam Festival, and it's clear the experience fell short of expectations. Frankly, we pushed this demo out in haste to meet the festival deadline, relying on internal QA assessments that indicated stability on our systems. However, your feedback has been a crucial wake-up call.

Acknowledging this, we've made the difficult decision to withdraw the demo from the festival. We extend our deepest apologies for any frustration this has caused. It's disheartening for us to see our community not enjoying the game as intended. This project is our debut, fueled by immense passion, and we're committed to getting it right.

We're inviting you to join our Discord community to actively participate in shaping the game into something we'll all treasure. Plans are in place to conduct more closed tests, and we aim to involve as many of you as possible. Your insights will be invaluable.

https://discord.gg/rattenreich

Many of you have highlighted game-breaking bugs and performance issues, some of which we're aware of and others that are revelations. Rest assured, ongoing developments, including more stylized voice effects to match the characters' appearances (imagine more distinct, hissy rat voices), are in the works alongside additional features. Your direct feedback on Discord, particularly in the demo feedback section, will be instrumental in guiding these improvements.

We're earnestly asking for your help and feedback to ensure we learn from this experience. Our commitment to not repeating these mistakes is unwavering.

Thank you for your understanding and support. We're eager to collaborate with you and earn back your trust.

Warm regards,

METALLADLERSTUDIO Team

notes.title: Early access combat vehicles
notes.content:
The main battle tank of the Rat Empire. An improved model of the first rat tank - StahlPfirsich AM. Developed by the KUFF concern, 10 years before the Great War. The tank's armor is based on a special steel alloy, which is 2 times stronger than any ordinary steel, has good maneuverability and performs well in all situations. The main function is to break through enemy defenses and support infantry. Rats always combine tank and infantry attacks. In the game, the tank is a reliable vehicle that can withstand a large number of hits from enemy guns, and also give them a worthy response. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/4e94d70e08aa81330abeb94c8577ed3b29f0c4df.png[/img]

Military resources did not allow equipping the army with armored vehicles in the required quantity, so the KUFF concern developed the PDRF armored infantry vehicle. A maneuverable vehicle designed for fighting infantry and transporting its own forces on the line of combat contact. It has reinforced wheels and high off-road capability. Performs 2 main functions in the game, fighting enemy infantry and transporting allied forces to the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/a1e59c3d55937c63695730e5d18dc5dc229e83c8.png[/img]

The KUFF concern, in a series of experiments, created the KugelPanzer tank . The Emperor really liked the tank, but it turned out to be expensive and ineffective. Most of the vehicles were transferred to desert colonies to protect the borders. However, the machine performed well in the colonial wars, so it was decided to create a new plant in the colony. The main task is to absorb enemy damage and draw fire onto yourself, giving your forces a chance to advance into hard-to-reach areas of the front. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/94d0e1e9adf57066b6acf01e1d468b094523254f.png[/img]

Project of a light combat vehicle of mixed type and purpose. It was created by rats to control colonial territories. A simple and mobile combat vehicle that serves as both a tank and a maneuverable infantry armored vehicle. However, in the Imperial Chancellery, this machine seemed specific and risky. A trial batch took part in a border conflict in the tropics, where the Red Dragon took possession of the vehicles, which over the course of several years not only made this vehicle the main equipment in the army, but also founded many productions of these vehicles, calling them JSH. The JSH serves as both an armored vehicle and a tank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/9aaf640adeb20d08018f1499feb2bc1d8084cd9e.png[/img]

The main enemies for the Empire of the Rising Sun are: infantry, traps, a series of small fortifications and mines. Therefore, the Empire produced the Kiosa light tank for many years - a cheap, easily replaceable, water-crossing tank. A tank that can take any army by surprise in quantity and speed. It is a cheap and versatile tank that deals damage to both infantry and enemy vehicles, targeting their weak spots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/267f449e4b7f8543b7c770426b4651d5a6d23874.png[/img]

Medium tank of the Lizards . It was created together with rat engineers to combat enemy equipment and fortifications. The Rats and Lizards assumed that in the event of an invasion of the Tropical Continent, the mice would saturate the Red Dragon army with equipment to slow down the advance of the Sun Empire. Albedo has become a good solution for fighting enemy vehicles in the tropics. Excellent against any enemy vehicle, however, the tank is expensive and slow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/624da39d88e821c80b39dbcbeebbbac3a0344235.png[/img]

PDRF - Sayonara. The Rats, being allies of the Empire of the Sun, modernized one third of their armored personnel carriers for tropical roads and gave them to the Lizards. In case of a quick victory in the Tropics, the Empire planned to develop an offensive on all the islands and completely oust the FMR. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/777aebdb0d0f515f961fa508e230a717afa88258.png[/img]

A tank created by FMR to fight Rat tanks. The command of the united forces of the mice decided to create a simple and easy-to-use tank, which could saturate the army with a huge amount of armored vehicles, which in turn would allow them to level forces with the enemy. As planned, for every one rat tank there are at least two TF01 tanks. They are inferior in their armor, but can act in groups and are very cheap to produce. A month before the Empire of the Rising Sun invaded the Tropical Continent, TF01s were sent to the Red Dragon in huge numbers straight from the factories to strengthen the ground forces. The main task of these tanks is to fight enemy equipment, cover infantry and protect defensive lines. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/537ea8011cebb815cd131329956cb88f0dc0c49a.png[/img]

At first, a simple RMTA transport vehicle was a means of transport for infantry, however, strengthening this vehicle with armor plates and a machine gun turret quickly showed that such a vehicle could serve not only as an armored personnel carrier, but also work to suppress infantry, clearing out enemy pillboxes and causing serious damage to armored vehicles enemy. Large quantities of RMTA are constantly sent not only to the front of the Central Continent, but also to the Tropical Continent to support the Red Dragon's forces. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/0ef853cffb798801fc595339727f870e619389bb.png[/img]

The heavy tank of mice is a formidable defender of the fields. The FVIX tank, an expensive luxury of the 
Mouse Army that causes a lot of problems for the rats. It is difficult to use anti-tank missiles in an offensive, so infantry and vehicles go into battle, and a tracked fortress like the FVIX can become a real bastion on the battlefield. The task of this technique is to protect important lines and play a major role in a massive attack. An unmaneuverable, but well-armored tank perfectly breaks through enemy positions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/f4d3a34bd7dca18e1cd5204e402432f3430ba992.png[/img]

We also want to show off the work our comrades Argentum Studio did for our Cinematic Trailer on IGN.

notes.title: RattenReich Gameplay moments
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/364af5e98db253c7684a5bdbe861ef6930174cf2.jpg[/img]

We would like to demonstrate shooting from a stationary machine gun in-game and its effectiveness. If you see the lines of an enemy fortification - trenches, pillboxes, bunkers, etc. - then you can be sure to turn the tides of battle by turning advancing soldiers into minced meat with a rain of metal. Therefore, running into frontal attacks without covering equipment and artillery is very unprofitable, if not completely foolish.

There is only one soldier in the machine gun crew, but its effectiveness and ease of replacement training forces the enemy to sit longer in their trenches and shelters. Nobody wants to be the target of this machine gun. The rate of fire makes it possible to cover large masses of the enemy with fire, and the tripod almost completely extinguishes dispersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/3b10d03e93ee595587506c80d04a4b657ffe786e.gif[/img]

Machine guns are certainly good, but they are unlikely to stop enemy tanks. For this, in trenches or in specially prepared places on the front line, it’s best to utilize anti-tank guns. Anti-tank guns can effectively hit infantry using high-explosive fragmentation shells. This is a very vulnerable target for enemy artillery, but it’s one of the only effective means of fighting against enemy tanks. Anti-tank guns come in different types: single-shot and multi-shot, both newer and older generations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/5253023eaf1e3cf334c6ed4de1d22646441b83d6.gif[/img]

We are trying to make a project with an emphasis on deep development, so we want the player to interact with as much as possible in the world around them. Namely, we want players to be able to pick up weapons on the battlefield - both their own and the enemy’s - and be able to take cover in all logical action locations. Trenches and shelters are designed in a way that takes player convenience into account. By prioritizing the player, one can make the most of the objects in the level: cross the trenches on the bridge, hide from artillery shelling, discover special, deeper trenches, or fire at the enemy in interconnected and smaller trenches.

An ordinary unit in the game is both a simple combat unit and a multifunctional tool for the player. A unit can pick up different types of weapons, heal itself, use a gas mask, occupy shelters, guns, control and transport equipment, can throw gas and fragmentation grenades, call for artillery fire support or airstrike, transport guns, not to mention individual special abilities of different classes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/a2e77fc424a726eea9d13d7d47aa536905dfe2d6.gif[/img]

With improper use of units, this becomes a combat mass with a very limited life expectancy. With proper management, this is an important combat unit. To run in a crowd towards machine guns or competently move into the depths of the enemy's defenses to attempt saving more personnel - it’s your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/f3c6a5676a51f3421a4e87baedb187f7af61115b.gif[/img]

A very important task of the player is to capture and hold points. This brings up important resources for us; resources that allow us to call in reinforcements in the form of infantry, guns or equipment, as well as the use of auxiliary abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/c5e072e0d96698259787bc0ea1ef7916fcd06c00.gif[/img]


For competent management of your troops, you will be shown unit cards with important information about the characteristics of units. Examples of characteristics include: health level, ammunition, class, equipment and gun cards, and the display of the number of crew and types of shells. Additionally, the cards have built-in functionality for quickly changing weapons and are interactive, like the minimap.

notes.title: Tank Arsenal and Soldier Corps 🐭
notes.content:
Hello friends,
Battles in the swamps are a never ending meat grinder in the mud. What was once a landscape at its prime is now nothing more than a suffocating wasteland of gas and ash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/743505dd4e4761e6c3237fba38ed5fbef58a9a93.jpg[/img]

War came to the Tropical Continent long before the world's greater conflict happened. The Rats had created an expeditionary force consisting of 500,000 soldiers equipped with an old arsenal of machinery and military equipment. The Rats built the Imperial Chancellery in the capital of the Empire of the Rising Sun and, until the very end of the war, they helped the Lizards in their affairs on the Tropical Continent.
Check out our game models of the soldiers of the Katon Corps. These Rat Soldiers were sent to help the Lizards fight for the Eastern Throne in the Tropical Continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/ce8ee28a431855000591877425ec3dc46f97673b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/ca4f5d7737b8ccf61ad4a33731f755b6eca22e51.png[/img]

Due to the abundance of iron on the Tropical Continent, Lizardmen began to mine in the occupied territories. The Empire of the Rising Sun began to build medium tanks to break through the Red Dragon’s fortifications in the North. They performed surprisingly well in combat.
The Albedo, a light tank of the Lizardmen, is used everywhere on the Tropical Continent. This heavy piece of machinery is included in all divisions of the Army of the Empire of the Sun.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/b54dcfeeb04c1af361387f6cc68cd7b4a81bca4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/53af108a8e974959dee618d5b333c1a5a2a65caf.png[/img]

According to the military doctrine of the Lizards, in each division - even generic infantry - there were corps, assault, and reconnaissance detachments equipped with these tanks. This is the largest tank in the war for the Eastern Throne. The volume of these tanks outweigh the amount of armored cars. Due to their maneuverability and relatively cheap cost, the tanks were used for amphibious assault and employed mostly for sea landings.
The ultralight Lizard tank of the Empire of the Rising Sun, Kyosa, is the most widely used battle tank on the Tropical Continent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/130fd75c72524fbc1434ceff5e6fc08da4b7e53d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/d92c5df00cf7679c9eaa103a80ff21462bef1b1e.png[/img]

Civil aviation of the Mouse Republic was - and still is - the main shipping method for trading and transport. It is used to deliver goods from villages to the city and vice versa.
In time, Mice were faced with the problem of supplying small villages due to the underdeveloped railway system. Luckily, brilliant minds designed a way to solve the supply problem. Thousands upon thousands of airships now fly across the territories of Mouse States.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/6547627495930176b32033f3a3e0cb52d3cb3234.png[/img]

If the enemy does not have air superiority, this is an excellent means of reconnaissance as an uncanny but effective way of bombing enemy positions.
Mice battle balloons are often used as such reconnaissance vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/af912ff242e1758dc8e69168b46e3baa4d19bad8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/0bcda93b6724200159b0db8ffad737b82cd1f638.png[/img]

The infantry machine gun, Genkai, is used in the Eastern Wars and is common among Lizard Troops.
This weapon is supplied to the Rats via the exchange program. Genkai is not the most convenient machine gun but, as practice has shown, recruits are not to be given more than 15 rounds. Therefore, a light machine gun with a small clip saved countless ammunition for the Empires, preventing recruits from wasting ammo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/737746b8f2cbc1d63a6bc6f50f5d246957243e6e.png[/img]

Weapons are supplied by the Mouse Republic and some are assembled in factories by the Lizards themselves. Everything is given to fight the Empire of the Sun.
A standard pistol like the one below has long been in service with the Lizard Infantry of the Red Dragon Empire.

notes.title: New Artwork, Weapons, and More
notes.content:
Mission loading screen background.
Players will have to storm the City of the Republic. Republic City is an anthill that is full of fortifications and traps. The player will have to fight fierce battles for every street with huge - yet unavoidable - losses among their squad. The assault will have to be carried out by a large number of infantry and a small number of specific vehicles. This organization is necessary due to the narrow streets and anti-tank hedgehogs that will interfere with the free movement of the heavy tanks around the city. 
The urban area will be a double edged sword for the player. The player will be able to use an abundant number of streets for tactical maneuvers with the aim of infiltrating behind enemy lines. However, this will make them susceptible to ambushes organized by the enemy. A huge number of city buildings can act as convenient shelters for defense, as well as a heavy bunker used to gather forces or to strengthen a rally point for assault.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/605d97f7d5563228f6eab26f2f5d7da1d79df686.jpg[/img]

Screensaver art for the mission, Katon.
This artwork depicts a massive offensive led by the Rat Empire corps which was sent to aid the Rising Sun Empire who are assaulting the dense jungles of the Red Dragon Empire. The player will feel all the hardships of the war in the jungle: the lack of heavy equipment, a huge number of ambushes, clever traps, and supply problems. The main offensive on this front is carried out by the poorly trained but numerous forces of the Empire of the Rising Sun and by the elite units of the infantry corps of the Rat Empire. 
For better or worse, the army of the Red Dragon Empire hasn’t gone too far and the troops aren’t better than an average conscript. Sadly, the excellent defensive positions will be a trump card in their hands. Will it matter that some of the soldiers were given a rifle for the first time? You will decide.


“Snake’s tail” mission loading screen background.
Prepare for the defense of the FMR colonial lands located in the Desert Continent. Your objective is to slow down the Rats’ mass offensive by any means possible. However, the onslaught of artillery and the pride of Rat engineering, doesn’t leave much of a chance for survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/48e9a315516d844f4f05a453469903fb89ac12f6.jpg[/img]

“Defense of Fortress 91, Sector 4” mission loading screen background.
The colonial troops of the Rat Empire are actively attacking the desert front. In turn, although the FMR lost some of its territory, it managed to prepare excellent defensive positions. The player will find themselves in conditions of a severe shortage of manpower and resources, but will have excellent and impenetrable fortifications. This will provide a huge advantage in defense. The main strategy for this mission will be to bleed the enemy of its manpower - since they will relentlessly launch massive attacks - then switch to a counterattack on the weakened positions of the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/15dbd192ccd062756e793544a8ccdf467f56d5f2.jpg[/img]

Kugelpanzer tank.
The Rats combat mini-tank designed for cheap and massive assaults on fortified enemy positions. When the issue of effectively managing a lightning breakthrough grew to an Empire-wide scale, Kufin’s factories received an order for 4,500 vehicles to, in turn, implement one into each available unit. This abomination was used extensively in the war on the Western Front which led to an easy victory over Mice at the beginning of the war. Cheap and cheerful. This is the only way to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/00736aa72f455ed062cd4c9c6158f6f956e57611.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/523fb9de91f19c5e31c80aad237b1d5dc8f44d23.png[/img]

Game ready model of a soldier from the Colonial Army of Rats.
These brave fighters were sent by the millions to the other side of the world to control and capture new colonies in the name of the Rat Empire. After a logistical disaster, they were still able to effectively carry out orders from the mainland for over 2 years, after which they took up defense. They were the main threat to their rivals on the desert front.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/210e7eec10324368de698bebe5c87509bffa856e.png[/img]

Rising Sun Empire Grenade Launcher - Ichigo.
An effective weapon for war that has high explosive and incendiary ammunition. Proven to be useful on more than one occasion in battles for the eastern front and in the jungles of the Red Dragon. Used by the Rat Army in the Desert Continent and the Central Continent, the multiple charges of this weapon are loved by fighters as they can fire away with full disregard for safety. Sadly, recharging the weapon takes a lot of time. The shooter must load blank cartridges and, only then, can the shells themselves be placed. When fired, the cartridge detonates and the gasses push out the live projectile. Due to the small caliber of the cartridge (which pushes a rather heavy projectile), the weapon has a short range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/fe2be0886e79d448bb1044ba5535f55d1115af05.png[/img]

A prop for urban and rural areas of the Central Continent. Favorite Mouse “Tool” for agriculture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/bf2e4630db720acda4c25d59dba3b84e2846ba6b.jpg[/img]

Props for a train and the railroad itself, equipped with transport and fuel composition of the Rats.
The most common symbol of the war and civil life of the Empire. It is this miracle of engineering that delivers soldiers, ammunition, weapons, and provisions to the front. These Trains can be seen anywhere the Rats go and their flags flutter above all.

notes.title: RattenReich Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/99a8dc1aef9b50143773eab36bf426bcf112bf45.jpg[/img]

Dear friends, we continue to tell you about our project in the next update. In this update, we will talk about the new technique and progress in the creation of new models. We are also moving forward in creating new game mechanics and will try to show them in the next updates.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Citizens of the Ratten Reich, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/96fbbdfe0a25d4d6ab9b03a0414bc772ff4b3794.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/2dc3dd6f6a6b78099b343e04d6dbf04fa19a6215.jpg[/img]

We have prepared a new batch of news for you! Let's start with an overview of the new cockroach concept.

The heavy infantry of the tsarist army instills fear in the souls of any soldiers that cross their path, but the cockroach infantry is more than just a scary bedtime story. The best cockroaches have been hardened by battle and are selected for heavy infantry; they undergo additional training with heavy equipment. Due to their anatomical features, cockroaches are one of the most feared enemies that can be found in the trenches. In close combat, cockroaches gain a huge advantage due to their anatomy; they have 4 “hands” which allows them to wield multiple melee weapons at once. 

Another feature of the cockroach is their natural armor - their carapace. Such armor is ineffective against bullets but, in close combat, it can protect against small wounds. The equipment of such soldiers consists of a cuirass, a special protective helmet with a mask, a saber, and a rifle. Although the equipment of the tsarist army may differ (some cockroaches have trophy weapons and pillaged equipment), squads of heavy infantry are continuously sent into the most bitter cauldrons of the war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/238e9c2a992fcab031bf20c1cb3a7aaf66b33dc6.jpg[/img]


Violet Ackermann


Violet Ackermann, Head of the Imperial Chancellery. A participant in the Desert War, a close friend of Kuffins, in addition to the emperor himself. The entire system of recruitment and unit dispatch - as well as the military communications departments - are at her disposal. She often personally commands small squads to collect intelligence. The Imperial Chancellery is the bureau for army communication and supplies, as well the most innovative branch of the emperor's regime when it comes to spy technologies. These technologies supply the empire's spy networks and communications. Often, these are monolithic concrete towers. For example, in the capital of the empire, the Imperial Chancellery is 88 meters. This woman is the personification of the protection of women in the era of war. She is the initiator of the voluntary troop conscription among women. It is through her merit and political influence that the government does not allow the mass conscription of women to the front, but does advocate for the voluntary elite corps. Violet Ackermann handles these militia infantry groups and the women's guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/cd8a5a3af187738e430d88e2fb9ed202a7dbd652.jpg[/img]

Kuffins Kuff


Kuffins Kuff is the heir to the Koff industry, which produces 90% of all military equipment and 40% of all consumer goods. As a cult personality, faithful companion, and right hand of the emperor, Kuffins is the Chief Engineer of the Empire. He is a Veteran of the Desert War and the war for the Sun Emperor's throne. There is not a single rat that Kuffins and the Emperor do not care about. Kuffins, in addition to being a master of engineering, is also an army general for the ^Geist^. He is simply incapable of sympathy for his soldiers and, therefore, will make any sacrifice necessary. Victory by any odds must be assured. His army consists almost entirely of tank corps. His political influence is immense, as is his loyalty to the Emperor and the Empire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/e553fe43bdf552eb25f80f88afb77ae2bbc24d8f.jpg[/img]

The soldiers of the Empire of the Sun


The soldiers of the Empire of the Sun are small gears that are responsible for the operation of the entire mechanism, represented by the great Empire. They are armed with old and new weapons, have excellent combat skills, and they fully devote their lives to serving the Empire of the Sun. If necessary, they are ready to go on a sacrificial attack on the enemy. Most of their weapons were supplied by the allied country RR (i.e. tanks and aircraft), but they also possess their own weapons that are ultimately inferior to the weapons of other countries. Such a lag in production capacity is due to the long feudal period - the outdated foundations of the Empire - the constant war with the Red Dragon, and the location of the islands. They also supply Amaterasu-class battleships to the RR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/cb7a911a43a6599920386d992053fa1e67bc15c3.jpg[/img]

New Fur

We tried revamping the fur for our characters. In the screenshot below, you can see an ordinary infantryman of the Ost West army of the Ratten Reich. What you see in this image is in early development. In the future, we will improve the fur of our characters to offer a more polished look.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/465c7b7a460cba10788b7fdf4b1c50e293c45fce.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/2904f9dea8f345441c9b023697301b9d95c871ad.png[/img]


New Models


Introducing the basic FMR revolver. This model is abundantly produced at the factories of Angul. It is the go-to pistol for everybody in the FMR. It has a simple and reliable design which has subsequently made this weapon a favorite firearm for the soldiers. Now, this basic revolver makes regular appearances in the holsters of the highest ranked officers. It owes its mass quantity to pre-war production and the ability to withstand the test of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/0c147c9de1fcb9f7474d15c76b8efbdd8e177d06.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/7782436e976339f75803f447c72d4afd8d0eee4f.jpg[/img]


Rodent Coffin TF-01 Tank


The engineers named this tank TF-01 but, at the frontline, this tank received a far different name: the Rodent Coffin. Due to the thickness of the armor and the tight quarters inside, it was granted its iconic nickname. This nickname characterizes its technical aspects as well; since a single vehicle is hardly a threat to enemy vehicles, it is otherwise able to hold back onslaughts of infantry. When there are dozens of Rodent Coffins on the battlefield, even a masterfully crafted war machine will have a hard time. Also, this tank is quite maneuverable and cheap to manufacture which is the main variable that allows the FMR to mass-produce these units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/899603246b3d10ac313bb6cce28f38252222f570.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/1b529952a2468ad6d2a48643a1fe9f89ff7af596.jpg[/img]

Armored Vehicle VH-1 FMR


This vehicle was created to support the infantry. To this end, 2 machine guns were installed on the armored vehicle to create suppressive fire. To protect the crew, the turret was reinforced with additional armor plates at a slight angle to ricochet incoming bullets and shells. At the front, this design choice has proven itself to be very effective. Overwhelming power and maneuverability justified the production of this armored vehicle, but due to the desire to save resources in production, a fatal mistake was made. Instead of tracks, wheels were put on the car. This decision had a negative effect on the off-road capability of the vehicle, as well as making the wheels an easy target for infantry.

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/4ea79a6e474c42b5454aec9d41e292bcd11585df.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/213b43e5a822e7f8ab64f84ab605d2b498dde566.jpg[/img]


FMR Transport Vehicle


Due to the need for multifunctional vehicles, the FMR created its own original machine; the chassis of which a huge number of other models were built for varying needs. This transport was used for peaceful purposes - such as the transportation of goods and construction - in addition to its military contributions. Due to the variety of modifications, the technical characteristics of this machinery also vary. The first models had a number of problems with steam engines. Higher FMR officials claimed that this is a completely original design, but among ordinary residents, there are rumors that the schematics were stolen from the Ratten Reich and that the FMR model was made from the blueprints of those secret documents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/4a27bd30455bec6f95b57979a7d31ef59ca8b66a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/8cad3adfcbb20d6d3cbd15750dcb8582551ea09b.png[/img]


FMR Rifle


The FMR was never famous for its weaponry. This rifle was produced long before the war, so it has a number of drawbacks in the form of frequent jams and misfires. Some models are so old that they have problems with the external condition of the weapon (i.e. serious rust and cracks on the wooden stock). The FMR is slowly phasing out this rifle model and moving on to a newer design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/6508b80b18c7dade7af2cf0a65ff24bdfad4e3c5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/0e67d3b81833a16ff05e952246ef986ee04e7489.png[/img]


Eisenbrecher


Old artillery of the Ratten Reich. It has a number of imperfections: heavy weight, poor aiming, outdated ammunition, but the Eisenbrecher is still superior to its FMR counterparts. New, more advanced models are coming to replace this artillery. In this regard, Eisenbrecher is used to protect and break through unimportant positions. The gun is mounted on the chassis of some machinery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/4aced054dcb9a96ab50c0f7c6967596c4ea684db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41180237/63be6e8d337d366a864eaaebb7e6adf6ec943180.png[/img]
